nodes.label: ADR-010: Dedicated Relationship Subsystem
nodes.rationale: Rejected raw semantic tags in Memory (parsing thousands of events per turn to extract active contacts and open plans is slow) and modeling contacts as identity traits (identity evolves slowly, contacts and collaborative goals change frequently — blending them violates single responsibility). Memory stores events, Identity models the user's character, Relationship models the external social network. Status: Proposed.

nodes.label: Relationship Context
nodes.rationale: Isolating social data in one structured output also serves privacy: records can be inspected or cleared without touching the rest of the database.
